example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গণাগোষ্ঠী সবাই মিলে উৎসব উদযাপন করল।
example_sentences_in_english: His kith and kin all gathered to celebrate the festival.
He overcame the hardship with the help of his relatives and kinfolk.
note: This term refers to a collective of close relatives, emphasizing familial bonds in Bengali social context.
